```yaml
name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy-modal:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install modal

      - name: Deploy to Modal
        run: bash distributed/deploy/modal-deploy.sh

  deploy-railway:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install Railway CLI
        run: npm install -g @railway/cli

      - name: Deploy to Railway
        run: railway init && railway up

  deploy-fly-io:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install flyctl
        run: curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        run: bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh

  deploy-render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Deploy to Render
        # Assuming there's a button or API to trigger Render deployments
        run: echo "Deploying to Render..."

  deploy-daytona:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Create Daytona instance
        run: daytona create
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up jobs for deploying the application to five different platforms: Modal, Railway, Fly.io, Render, and Daytona. Each job checks out the code, sets up the necessary environment, and runs the deployment script or command specified for each platform. Note that the Render deployment step is currently a placeholder since the exact method to trigger a Render deployment is not provided in the request.
